content:
Dear colleagues,

Talmenta. We incorporated Talmenta Inc. to transition mathematical research from the master-apprentice model to a management-based system, enabling mathematicians worldwide to profit from AI engineers and technology. We operate by dispatching research managers to working mathematicians, recruiting collaborators and experts.

Mathematicians need technology. Our intention is to engage Axiom Math, Google DeepMind, OpenAI or Meta Research as technology partners. While we held more than 40 discussions with these and other stakeholders over the past weeks, they are unconventionally secretive, at the disadvantage of the entire mathematical community that craves fair access to AI-assisted mathematics. Therefore, with the help of Karthik Viswanathan, we decided to start a community effort to build an AI-assisted mathematics assistant.

Power to the people. It is completely unclear whether this project succeeds, but it increases the pressure on Axiom Math to make their methods available to the public, adds an additional assistant that can later be chained with Axiom Math's, and provides mathematicians with hope that the future of their discipline is still in their hands. By mathematicians, for mathematicians, in the benefit of the community!

Next steps. This is supposed to become a large project among the mathematical community with multiple contributors, organized and managed by Talmenta. See verified-math-assistant-proposal.pdf for details. Apply at jasper.kreeke@talmenta.org.

Best wishes
Jasper
